system.description:
Smart Lock Make an Interface Roll (15)
onan object you're touching that can
close, such as a lock, chest, door, box,
panel, safe, or case. Once per rest ona
success, you encrypt, reinforce, and
seal the object so it can only be opened
by creatures with your password.
Someone with access to compatible
technology and an hour of time to
study the protocol can break it.
Emergency Door: When you have no
adversaries within Melee range, make
an Interface Roll (13). On a success,
spend a Hope to open a short-range
transit door, breach route,
displacement panel, or emergency
passage from where you are to a point
within Far range you can see. It closes
once a creature has passed through it.
Reveal: Make an Interface Roll. If there
is anything technologically, digitally, or
artificially hidden within Close range, it
is revealed.
